buy.intro: From pre-approval to closing day, here's how buying a home works in Northeastern Pennsylvania — and how to get started.

process.intro: Every purchase is a little different, but most follow the same core steps.

steps.description: Talk with a lender to understand your budget and get a pre-approval letter before you shop.

steps.title: Search for homes

steps.description: Order a home inspection to understand the property's condition and any needed repairs.

financing.intro: Understanding your financing early makes the whole process smoother.

items.description: Know what you can comfortably afford before you start touring homes.

items.title: Loan options
items.description: Compare conventional, FHA, VA and other programs with a licensed lender.

items.title: Closing costs
items.description: Plan for costs beyond the down payment, such as fees, taxes and insurance.

faqs.q: How much do I need for a down payment?
faqs.a: It varies by loan program — some allow low down payments. A lender can explain the options you qualify for. This is general information, not a loan commitment.

faqs.q: Do I need a real estate agent to buy?
faqs.a: You're not required to, but a buyer's agent can guide you through offers, negotiations and closing. You can find professionals on our Realtors page.

faqs.q: How long does buying a home take?
faqs.a: From accepted offer to closing is commonly around 30–45 days, though timelines vary with financing and inspections.

faqs.q: Are the listings on this site real?
faqs.a: Not yet. Listings shown are clearly-labeled samples. Live MLS/IDX listings will be added in a later phase.

items.title: Credit awareness

credit.title: Understanding credit
credit.intro: Your credit affects the loan options and rates available to you. A few habits can help over time.
items: Check your credit report for errors and dispute anything inaccurate.
Pay bills on time — payment history is a major factor.
Keep credit-card balances low relative to your limits.
Avoid opening new credit or making large purchases right before applying.

programs.title: Loan programs to learn about
programs.intro: First-time buyers often explore these program types with a licensed lender. Availability and terms vary.
programs.note: These are general references only and do not represent an offer or a determination of eligibility. A licensed lender or the relevant agency must verify what you qualify for.

items.title: Conventional loans
items.description: Common loans not backed by a government agency; terms vary by lender.

items.title: FHA loans
items.description: Government-insured loans that can allow lower down payments for eligible buyers.

items.title: VA loans
items.description: For eligible veterans and service members, often with favorable terms.

items.title: USDA loans
items.description: For eligible buyers in qualifying rural areas.

items.title: PA first-time programs
items.description: Pennsylvania offers programs for eligible first-time buyers — ask a lender or PHFA.

faqs.q: How much do I need for a down payment?
faqs.a: It depends on the loan program — some allow lower down payments. A lender can explain what you qualify for. This is general information, not a loan commitment.

faqs.q: What credit score do I need?
faqs.a: Requirements vary by loan program and lender. Understanding and improving your credit widens your options; a lender can review your specific situation.
Closing costs vary but are commonly a few percent of the purchase price. Your lender will provide estimates specific to your loan.

faqs.q: Do first-time buyer programs guarantee I'll qualify?
faqs.a: No. Program references here are educational only. Eligibility is always determined by the lender or agency, not by this site.

about.intro: Real Estate in NEPA is an independent regional real estate information platform for Northeastern Pennsylvania.

sections.heading: Our mission
body: We help people explore homes, communities, market insights and real estate resources across Northeastern Pennsylvania — in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
Our goal is to be a genuinely useful, trustworthy local resource for buyers, sellers, investors and anyone considering a move to the region.

sections.heading: What we are — and what we're not
body: Real Estate in NEPA is an information platform. It is not a licensed brokerage, mortgage lender, law firm, or financial advisor. We do not sell homes, originate loans, or provide legal or financial advice.
Where you see sample listings, market figures, articles or professional profiles marked as samples, they are for demonstration only and do not represent real data.

sections.heading: Editorial policy
body: We aim for content that is accurate, neutral and clearly sourced. Market data and factual claims are intended to carry source attribution.
Educational content is general in nature and should be independently verified with qualified professionals.

sections.heading: Advertising & sponsorship disclosure
body: In the future, some placements — such as featured professional profiles or sponsored content — may be paid.
Any paid or sponsored placement will be clearly labeled and kept distinct from editorial content.

sections.heading: Corrections
body: We correct errors promptly. If you spot something inaccurate, please contact us and we'll review it.

sections.heading: Sources
body: Factual market articles are designed to reference verified sources such as public records and MLS data once those integrations are connected. Until then, figures are clearly labeled as samples.

privacy.metaDescription: How Real Estate in NEPA handles the limited information you choose to provide.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it. It is a general template and should be reviewed by a qualified professional before launch.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: We collect only what you choose to provide through our forms — such as your name, email, phone number, preferred language, area of interest and message.
We do not ask for sensitive information such as financial account numbers or government identification.

sections.heading: How we use your information
body: We use your details to respond to your inquiry and, if you subscribe, to send you the updates you requested. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Sharing
body: We may share the information you submit with the resource best suited to help you — for example, routing a request to a professional. Any such sharing is limited to fulfilling your request.

sections.heading: Cookies & analytics
body: We aim to keep third-party scripts minimal. If analytics are added, they will be configured to respect your privacy, and non-essential cookies will be opt-in where required.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can unsubscribe from emails at any time, and you can contact us to ask about the information you've provided.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Questions about this policy? Reach us through our contact page.

terms.metaDescription: The terms that apply to using the Real Estate in NEPA website.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of this website. This is a general template and should be reviewed by a qualified professional before launch.

sections.heading: Acceptance
body: By using this site, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Informational use only
body: Content is provided for general informational and educational purposes. It is not legal, financial, tax or real estate advice, and should be independently verified.
Sample listings, market figures and profiles are clearly labeled and do not represent real data.

sections.heading: No professional relationship
body: Using this site does not create a brokerage, lending, legal or advisory relationship. Real Estate in NEPA is an independent information platform.

sections.heading: Third-party links & content
body: We may link to third-party sites and, in the future, list third-party professionals. We are not responsible for third-party content, and a listing is not an endorsement unless explicitly stated.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
body: The site is provided "as is" without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for decisions made based on information found here.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may update these terms. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated terms.

fairHousing.metaDescription: Real Estate in NEPA's commitment to fair housing and equal opportunity.
fairHousing.title: Fair Housing
fairHousing.intro: Real Estate in NEPA is committed to the principles of fair housing and equal opportunity.

sections.heading: Equal Housing Opportunity
body: We support the Fair Housing Act and the Equal Opportunity Act. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, disability, familial status, national origin, or any other protected class.

sections.heading: Neutral community information
body: Our community and city content is written to be neutral and factual. We do not steer users toward or away from communities based on protected characteristics, and we do not rank neighborhoods or make subjective claims about who a community is "best" for.

sections.heading: Schools & local data
body: For information about schools and local services, we point to official sources such as the Pennsylvania Department of Education and local districts, and we avoid subjective rankings.

sections.heading: Report a concern
body: If you believe any content conflicts with these principles, please contact us so we can review it.

accessibility.metaDescription: Real Estate in NEPA's commitment to an accessible experience for everyone.
accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: We want Real Estate in NEPA to be usable by everyone, regardless of ability.

sections.heading: Our approach
body: We aim to follow recognized accessibility best practices, targeting WCAG 2.2 AA guidance as we build.
This includes semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, sufficient color contrast, descriptive text alternatives, and support for reduced-motion preferences.

sections.heading: Ongoing work
body: Accessibility is an ongoing effort. As the platform grows, we continue to test and improve the experience across devices and assistive technologies.

sections.heading: Feedback
body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please let us know through our contact page and we'll work to address it.

hero.subhead: Real Estate, Homes for Sale & Community Guide

buyers.title: For Buyers
buyers.body: Look at the median price, days on market and active inventory to gauge competition. Low days on market and homes selling near asking usually mean moving quickly with financing ready; more inventory can give you room to negotiate.

sellers.title: For Sellers
sellers.body: Recent sale prices and how fast homes are going help you price realistically. Strong sale-to-list ratios and low days on market point to firm demand; more inventory makes presentation and pricing matter more.

investors.title: Investor Perspective
investors.body: Consider the mix of single-family and multifamily stock, typical price points, and rental demand from local employers and colleges. Always run each property's numbers individually.
